name: SNMP switches
description: Asks managed switches over SNMP v1 / v2c (read-only) which device is plugged into which port: the MAC address table and LLDP. Netlens shows each device's switch and port and places the switches in the hierarchy. Works with switches that have the standard bridge MIB (TP-Link, Netgear, HP / Aruba, Cisco, Zyxel, MikroTik, Ubiquiti and others). Verified against a real device; more switch models are welcome.
author: Netlens
supports: Managed switches with SNMP v1/v2c and the BRIDGE-MIB or Q-BRIDGE-MIB (verified on a real device)

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.

Switches are entered as a list: one line per switch with an optional community of its own (the default community covers the others), a Test button per line, and Test all. Existing settings carry over. Needs Netlens 0.3.109 or newer.
First release. Written from the standard MIBs and tested against simulated switches only: please test it on a real switch and report back (see the README).
